job.prompt:
Create a transparent production full-body character keyframe sheet. The character is our existing Claude woman: copper-orange long wavy hair, amber eyes, round thin gold glasses, orange flower ornament with dark ribbon. Preserve glasses across every outfit. Reference 1 defines exact character identity and wedding outfit; use its exact colors, textile details, ornaments and footwear in all four figures.  Reference 2 is original adult proportion/face only. Never borrow reference 2's clothes.
Keep ADULT 25+ anatomy, original mature face, approximately 7.5-8 heads tall, normal small head, long natural thighs and shins. Match original portrait's head-to-body ratio, torso length, waist, knee and ankle heights. Don't shorten legs to fit layout. Photorealistic 3D digital human rendering, lifelike skin, detailed hair and cloth. No chibi or doll proportions.
 Preserve reference portrait mature adult 25+ face, natural small head, long thighs and shins, about 7.5 head lengths tall. Photorealistic 3D digital human rendering. Preserve identity, face, hairstyle, ornament and exact outfit/footwear. Body and legs cannot shrink in later cells. No chibi or doll anatomy. Accurate connected fingers/wrists. No shadows, floor, backdrop, text, labels or grid. True transparent alpha. LAYOUT: FOUR complete FULL BODY figures, TWO COLUMNS and TWO ROWS, portrait 2048x2304 transparent atlas. The whole top row fits y=5% to 40%; the whole bottom row fits y=60% to 95%. Copy the SAME full-height base body at EXACTLY the same scale into every cell, then change ONLY arms/face for the gestures. Heads, waist, knees and ankles remain at identical cell-relative levels. Leave empty transparent space below all four pairs of shoes and between all hair and gowns. Keep full gown and veil inside each cell. No overlapping people. Do not crop or shorten anyone to fit the canvas. Order: top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right.  FOUR POSES:  1) Neutral full-body standing, both arms relaxed beside dress, calm smile. 2) Photo preparation: right hand moves up toward cheek, relaxed fingers, left arm rests by side. 3) Photo: natural right-hand two-finger V gesture beside cheek, gentle smile toward viewer, left arm down. 4) Happy relaxed full-body standing, friendly closed-mouth smile, both arms by sides. All four same straight standing legs and same adult face/body. Keep a completely empty horizontal transparent band across y=42% to 58%. Gowns and shoes must NOT TOUCH hair of the next row. All four bodies remain exact same mature scale. Wide horizontal transparent separation between skirts, no extra veil across gutters.
